usedFor: monday.com holds boards and Google Chat is where the team reads them, so “Item Column Value Changes” runs “Send Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “Item Column Value Changes” in monday.com, then “Send Message” in Google Chat
bestTemplate.why: A changed column posts to a chat space, so the team sees a status move without opening the board.

watchOut: “Item Column Value Changes” runs on any column update, so the same item can post to the space repeatedly.
